item.title: ZIMURA property disposal sparks internal board dispute
item.description: The Zimbabwe Music Rights Association (ZIMURA) has issued a public clarification on the disposal of two residential flats in Avondale amid growing public scrutiny, while a group of its own board members has formally distanced itself from the statement, citing governance and procedural concerns. item.title: Why Joburg’s entertainment hub still gives you the biggest head start
item.description: By Mzi Kaka South Africa’s media and entertainment sector is one of the country’s most exciting growth stories. PwC’s outlook shows that it is outperforming global benchmarks, driven by streaming, on-demand video, a resurgent film sector, and a live industry that has already surpassed its pre-pandemic revenue levels. item.title: Deezer unveils revamped Android TV app with enhanced music features
item.description: Deezer, the global music streaming platform, has launched a redesigned version of its Android TV app, offering an updated interface and expanded music features for users worldwide. The app has experienced steady growth on Android TV, prompting Deezer to reimagine the platform from the ground up. item.title: Open call: Live Music Lab 2026 training programme
item.description: Applications have opened for the 2026 edition of Live Music Lab, a fully funded training programme aimed at young people in Johannesburg seeking entry-level experience in the live music industry. The three-month programme, run by live music platform Bassline, will select 10 participants for an intensive combination of classroom learning and practical industry exposure. item.title: Wizkid and Asake release new collaborative single Jogodo
item.description: Nigerian artists Wizkid and Asake have released a new collaborative single, ‘Jogodo’, marking their latest joint project and the lead release from an upcoming EP titled REAL, Vol. 1. The track, released on 16 January, blends Afrobeats with prominent percussion and brass elements. Sung primarily in Nigerian Pidgin, ‘Jogodo’ centres on the idea of intoxication or being under the influence, a theme reflected in both its lyrics and relaxed, rhythmic production. item.title: Ayra Starr nominated in two categories at 2026 MOBO Awards
item.description: Nigerian singer Ayra Starr has received two nominations at the 2026 MOBO Awards, competing in both the Best African Music Act and Best International Act categories. Starr, who made history last year as the first African woman to win both awards simultaneously, faces a competitive field in this year’s edition. item.description: Rising Nigerian Afro-house artist and producer Damie joined Nandi Madida via FaceTime on Apple Music to talk about his latest single ‘One Minute’. item.title: Second Pretoria date added to UB40 featuring Ali Campbell SA tour
item.description: Promoters have added an additional Pretoria concert to the upcoming South African tour by UB40 Featuring Ali Campbell after the group’s initial show at SunBet Arena, Time Square sold out. The newly announced performance will take place on 7 June 2026, at the same venue. item.title: Open call: 2026 Pro Helvetia residency programme
item.description: Pro Helvetia has opened its annual call for its international residency programme, which supports artistic exchange, research and professional development through extended stays in new cultural contexts. item.title: SA rapper Usimamane featured on Apple Music’s Rap Life Africa
item.description: South African rapper Usimamane will feature on Apple Music’s Rap Life Africa this month, as host Nandi Madida and global editorial head of hip hop and R&B, Ebro Darden, discuss his latest single, Racks, and his project G-Wagon Music: Baby Tai.
